declared_before: any measurement result, fit, solver production run or render existed for this case
note: Tolerances are fixed before data and never relaxed after a failure. Case-specific checks may be added by the lead before production. Remove checks that do not apply and say why in the audit.

anchor_rule.jump: first half-cycle (or event) whose amplitude/period changes by > 3 sigma from the previous one
anchor_rule.drift: cumulative amplitude or period trend > 3 sigma relative to the first two cycles
anchor_rule.per_mode_windows: only for modes shown to be dynamically decoupled; disclosed as a deviation

physics_validation.P1_convergence: >= 3 levels in space and time; observed order within 0.5 of theory (or reported spread if non-monotone); finest-level difference below the case tolerance for every reported scalar and for the trajectory/field max norm
physics_validation.P2_independent_benchmark: verifier's solver (different method, no shared code) vs production at identical parameters: state difference < 1e-6 (ODE) or key scalars within 2 % (field solvers); event times within 1e-6 s
physics_validation.P3_analytic_limit: closed form or published benchmark in its regime: < 1e-7 relative (ODE), <= 0.5 % (structures), inside the published band (CFD)
physics_validation.P4_budget: conservative drift |dE|/E0 < 1e-8; dissipation non-negative and non-decreasing; balance residual < declared fraction; mass/tracer budget within declared %; divergence below declared norm
physics_validation.P5_constraints_saved_blend: reopened saved .blend at frames + 4 subframes: fixed anchors < 1e-6 m; declared lengths/attachments < 1e-6 m (1e-5 m visual); no interpenetration
physics_validation.P6_blend_vs_solver: evaluated transforms or mesh vs solver at frames + 4 subframes: < 1e-5 m / rad
physics_validation.P7_forces: tension >= 0, normal force >= 0 in contact, friction inside the cone if declared
physics_validation.P8_initial_conditions_time: initial state equals params; frame n <-> t = n/fps exactly; no time scaling
physics_validation.P9_control_response: parameter changes through the real build path change the dynamics as the equations predict, each from its own equilibrium
physics_validation.P10_repeatability: two clean rebuilds: identical keys, caches and evaluated transforms
physics_validation.L1_logistics: every moving prop has a visible cause; carried props <= {{MAX_PROP_SPEED_M_S}} m/s; no teleports, appearances or visibility toggles; counts consistent with the load at every time

reference_fidelity.note: Reported separately; a generated reference is not ground truth. Skip for input kind 'none'.
reference_fidelity.R1_tracking: per-frame uncertainty from two independent methods
reference_fidelity.R2_anchor: projected model vs track RMS inside the anchor window <= max(2 px, 3 sigma)
reference_fidelity.R3_divergence: after the anchor window: divergence map with named defects (not pass/fail)
reference_fidelity.R4_camera: static landmark reprojection RMS <= 2 px (<= 0.1 px for our own first frame)
reference_fidelity.R5_render_track: tracked feature in the final render vs model projection RMS <= 1 px

visual_review.V1: no shape change, sliding attachments, interpenetration, flicker or popping at turning points and contacts
visual_review.V2: all visible parts present; materials match by region metrics and 2-D luma profiles
visual_review.V3: side-by-side at identical t, no retiming; static silhouette IoU >= 0.9
visual_review.V4: observed vs hypothesis vs untested separated in the report
visual_review.V5: clean rebuild from the checkpoint reproduces it; manifest verifies
